name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-change-communication-pack
title: Change Communication Pack
shortDescription: Turns a Message Center post or roadmap item into a user announcement, service desk FAQ, SharePoint news draft and admin checklist.
longDescription: Reads a Message Center post, roadmap item or release note and extracts a confirmed fact sheet: what changes, who is affected, the timeline and admin actions.

Writes a consistent communication pack based only on the source: a user announcement, a service desk FAQ, a SharePoint news draft, an admin checklist and a list of open questions. Saves everything as one HTML file in the current site.
